label: 4th original token (r/h/n/x) after prefix q-{s,a}-{t,f}
explanation: Extremely sparse feature (41 of 1M sequences, never more than once per sequence, near-constant magnitude 0.10-0.14) that acts like a lookup on a few specific short prefixes that all involve q. The main mode, about half the mass, is the 4th original token (t=3) when it is r/h/n/x and comes right after the prefix q,{s|a},{t|f}, e.g. q s t [r], q a t [h]. The strongest activations are on q-s-t and q-a-t; q-a-f/q-s-f fire more weakly or not at all. Minor modes: the first copy step of L=3 sequences like q q a / q a a / 2 q a <DEL> [x] (q in position 0 or 1, a in position 2); the same s/a-t + r/x trigram at t=4 when q comes earlier (b q s t [r]); and t=7 in q g ? q sequences. It does not fire on the same trigrams without q (z s t r, h a t r are silent), and it never fires on the delimiter or on t<3. Generalizing the trigram drops precision to under 25%, so the feature is a narrow conjunction rather than a clean concept. Precision is high but recall is about 50%.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 17 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & out_tok=q (+2.36), prev3_tok=q (+2.27), prev2_tok=s (+2.06), orig0=q (+1.95), prev2_tok=a (+1.83), t=3 & prev_tok=f (+1.78). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-0.98), orig_idx=3 (-0.10).
